population.span: Those trial participants with hypoxia (oxygen saturation <92% on air or requiring oxygen therapy) and evidence of systemic inflammation (C-reactive protein ≥75 mg/L) were eligible for random assignment

endpoint.span: Outcomes were assessed at 28 days after randomisation to tocilizumab versus usual care alone, with further analyses specified at 6 months. The primary outcome was all-cause mortality.

estimate.span: Overall, 621 (31%) of the 2022 patients allocated tocilizumab and 729 (35%) of the 2094 patients allocated to usual care died within 28 days (rate ratio 0·85; 95% CI 0·76–0·94; p=0·0028).

ci.span: Overall, 621 (31%) of the 2022 patients allocated tocilizumab and 729 (35%) of the 2094 patients allocated to usual care died within 28 days (rate ratio 0·85; 95% CI 0·76–0·94; p=0·0028).

analysis_set.span: In accordance with the statistical analysis plan (version 2.1, ), an intention-to-treat comparison was done between patients who entered the randomised comparison of tocilizumab versus usual care.

treatment_strategy.span: usual standard of care alone versus usual standard of care plus tocilizumab at a dose of 400 mg–800 mg (depending on weight) given intravenously. A second dose could be given 12–24 h later if the patient's condition had not improved.

follow_up.span: Outcomes were assessed at 28 days after randomisation to tocilizumab versus usual care alone, with further analyses specified at 6 months.

served_mismatch: The served numerical estimate and CI match the reported 28-day mortality rate ratio. However, the source reports a log-rank mortality rate ratio, not an arm-count risk ratio or the OR specified in served_outcome.estimand. The served provenance describing an arm-level-count derivation is therefore incorrect.

candidate_rejections.span: Overall, 621 (31%) of the 2022 patients allocated tocilizumab and 729 (35%) of the 2094 patients allocated to usual care died within 28 days (rate ratio 0·85; 95% CI 0·76–0·94; p=0·0028).
candidate_rejections.why: Reject interpreting 0.85 (0.76–0.94) as an arm-count risk ratio or OR; retain these numbers as the explicitly reported mortality rate ratio.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled hospitalised adults with COVID-19, restricted to hypoxia and systemic inflammation; the reported mortality comparison used intention-to-treat analysis.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Here we report the results of a large randomised, controlled trial aimed at evaluating the effects of tocilizumab in adult patients hospitalised with severe COVID-19 characterised by hypoxia and substantial inflammation.

notes: All spans are from held full text. RR in bound_values denotes the source's rate ratio, estimated using log-rank statistics, not a cumulative risk ratio. Numeric strings preserve the printed decimal marks. No OR or recalculated effect is supplied.
